LESSON: WRITING 9.5.1 CREATIVE WRITING: NARRATIVE COMPOSITIONS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 9
Topic 9.5: Writing 9.5.1 Creative writing: Narrative compositions

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Writing 9.5.1 Creative writing: Narrative compositions. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Which things make a narrative composition memorable?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify features of a narrative composition in creative writing
2. create well-written narrative compositions on a variety of topics
3. appreciate the importance of writing in day-to-day life

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: WRITING 9.5.1 CREATIVE WRITING: NARRATIVE COMPOSITIONS
Subject: ENGLISH · Grade: Grade 7
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Writing 9.5.1 Creative writing: Narrative compositions helps you succeed in ENGLISH. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

KEY FACTS: WRITING 9.5.1 CREATIVE WRITING: NARRATIVE COMPOSITIONS
Language skills grow by daily practice: listen carefully, speak clearly, read every day, write neatly.
Model → guided practice → independent practice.
Always use complete sentences when writing answers.

PART 1: Identify features of a narrative composition in creative writing

What this means
In this part you learn to identify features of a narrative composition in creative writing. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: identify features of a narrative composition in creative writing.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model reading: Read a short paragraph about “Writing 9.5.1 Creative writing: Narrative compositions”, then retell it in 3 sentences.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can identify features of a narrative composition in creative writing. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Create well-written narrative compositions on a variety of topics

What this means
In this part you learn to create well-written narrative compositions on a variety of topics. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: create well-written narrative compositions on a variety of topics.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model speaking: Say 4 clear sentences about Writing 9.5.1 Creative writing: Narrative compositions to a partner.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can create well-written narrative compositions on a variety of topics. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Appreciate the importance of writing in day-to-day life

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the importance of writing in day-to-day life. You will use ideas from at school, at home, and in your community in Kenya.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the importance of writing in day-to-day life.
2. Listen, speak, read, then write using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Model writing: Write 5 neat sentences using new words from this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the importance of writing in day-to-day life. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Writing 9.5.1 Creative writing: Narrative compositions is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Read a short paragraph about “Writing 9.5.1 Creative writing: Narrative compositions”, then retell it in 3 sentences. (skill: identify features of a narrative composition in creative writing)

Example 2: Say 4 clear sentences about Writing 9.5.1 Creative writing: Narrative compositions to a partner. (skill: create well-written narrative compositions on a variety of topics)

Example 3: Write 5 neat sentences using new words from this lesson. (skill: appreciate the importance of writing in day-to-day life)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Writing 9.5.1 Creative writing: Narrative compositions to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: identify features of a narrative composition in creative writing.
3. Practise this skill: create well-written narrative compositions on a variety of topics.
4. Practise this skill: appreciate the importance of writing in day-to-day life.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Writing 9.5.1 Creative writing: Narrative compositions from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Writing 9.5.1 Creative writing: Narrative compositions: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 7 learner study Writing 9.5.1 Creative writing: Narrative compositions?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Which things make a narrative composition memorable?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Writing 9.5.1 Creative writing: Narrative compositions means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: identify features of a narrative composition in creative writing.
5. Be able to: create well-written narrative compositions on a variety of topics.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
